history.summary: 99-yr leasehold 1BR at Water Place, D15 (Tanjong Rhu), literally 120m (1 min) from TE23 Tanjong Rhu MRT, asking $1.35M at $1,844 PSF for an efficient 732 sqft. Reliable 91-txn URA base prints a strong 6.75%/yr; PSF is ~4% under the $1,920 median.
history.rating_rationale: Best location attribute in the batch — 120m to a TEL station is a rare, durable premium. Backed by a credible 91-txn URA series at 6.75%/yr (above RCR baseline), efficient 732 sqft layout, and slight PSF discount to median. $1.35M quantum is workable for D15. Offsets: 2004 build (~77yr lease remaining) and waterfront 99-yr lease decay, but the transit advantage and proven appreciation outweigh them.
red_flags: 2004 build, ~77yr lease remaining — lease decay over hold

Tanjong Rhu / Kallang Basin transformation, GSW-adjacent

history.summary: Rare 120m-to-TEL durable location premium, but the unit is an oversized 732sf '1BR' at only a slight discount, so the value case is thin once format is considered.
history.rating_rationale: 120m to a TEL station is a genuine, durable plus and the 91-txn series is credible, but 732sf is large for a 1BR (format/PSF caution) and the discount to median is only slight; the Buy leaned partly on a 6.75% trailing CAGR. Location strong, value thin → Neutral.
